[ce] CalcExpress - Variables Writer ID.vi

Owning Palette: CalcExpress

The VI presets or reads the Writer ID value applied to variable write operations executed by the given CalcExpress instance.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

CE InstanceRef is a reference number for a CalcExpress instance that contains a parsed CalcExpress expression/script. CalcExpress - Parse Script.vi returns a value that can be wired directly to this terminal.
writer ID in specifies the new value to preset. This value is only used if the set (F) control is TRUE.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
set (F) defines the action to perform. If FALSE (default), the VI returns the actual writer ID; otherwise, it sets a new value provided by the writer ID in control.
dup CE InstanceRef is a flow-through parameter with the same value as CE InstanceRef.
writer ID out returns the actual Writer ID value of the CalcExpress instance if the set (F) control is FALSE, or the previous value if set (F) is TRUE.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.

 

[ce] CalcExpress - Variables Writer ID.vi - details

Every CalcExpress instance holds its own Writer ID value, which is passed to VarMan during variable write operations. This value is initialized to 0 when the instance is created, but it can be altered before execution using this VI, or during script execution using the vwrid() function. A new value stays unchanged until it is explicitly altered again.
